datasets.name: PANDORA Talks
datasets.suggested_use: naturalistic Reddit benchmark with continuous big-5/OCEAN values and demographic fields but request/terms-limited reproducibility
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. ACL SocialNLP source (gjurkovic_2021) reports ~10,295 Reddit authors and ~17.6M English comments with continuous big-5/OCEAN values on a 0–100 style scale plus demographic metadata. Literature usage count is low despite solid DQI because request/terms access adds friction versus public Kaggle or Essays releases. Scoring rationale: high scale, observation depth, continuous trait resolution, and demographic metadata; theory coverage is scored as single-theory big-5/OCEAN rather than multi-theory.

theory.traits_or_labels: Continuous big-5/OCEAN values on a 0–100 style scale; age, gender, country, continent, and region-style demographic metadata
theory.instruments_or_method: Continuous trait values and demographic profile metadata reported in the source corpus
theory.multi_theory_notes: Single-theory big-5/OCEAN dataset; continuous values support regression, calibration, and ordinal analysis rather than binary class labels alone

provenance.label_source: Continuous big-5/OCEAN values and demographic profile metadata
provenance.collection_context: ~10,295 Reddit authors; ~17.6M English comments reported in source-page summary
provenance.access_and_license: Request form plus terms of use
provenance.known_limitations: Privacy and Reddit deletion constraints; requires terms-compliant reuse; independent reproduction depends on request approval

datasets.name: Kaggle dataset + focal-loss split protocol
datasets.suggested_use: self-declared MBTI benchmark with curated data and latest improved personality-stratified splitting
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Curated Kaggle dataset (jie_nd) with Kaggle dataset + focal-loss split protocol (tan_2025). Strong scale and observation under the improved split, but labels remain self-declared MBTI.

theory.instruments_or_method: Self-declared MBTI profile labels; not professionally administered MBTI
theory.multi_theory_notes: Large-scale MBTI benchmark with convenient four-dichotomy classification format

provenance.text_source: Online forum/social-media-style posts aggregated per user
provenance.label_source: Self-declared MBTI profile labels from the curated Kaggle release
provenance.known_limitations: Self-selection bias; self-declared labels; class imbalance

datasets.name: myPersonality
datasets.suggested_use: large-scale social-media measurement with valuable big-5 labels but strong governance limits
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Historically influential Facebook-linked big-5 resource with good scale and repeated digital behavior, but restricted/deprecated access substantially limits governance and reproducibility for new studies.

theory.traits_or_labels: Big Five O, C, E, A, N
theory.instruments_or_method: Self-report personality ratings linked to Facebook application participation
theory.multi_theory_notes: Historically central social-media personality dataset despite current access restrictions

provenance.text_source: Facebook application/status and platform behavioral records
provenance.label_source: Self-report ratings from myPersonality application users
provenance.known_limitations: Privacy, consent, and governance constraints limit reproducible reuse

datasets.name: ADAM-style language-agnostic augmentation
datasets.suggested_use: multilingual augmentation and transfer with required human/local validation for generated language
datasets.note: Type: augmented dataset. Language-agnostic multilingual augmentation (tan_2026). Receives language coverage credit, but theory score stays low because it inherits source-framework labels rather than validating a new theory mapping; generated/translated text needs human or local validation for full credit.

theory.traits_or_labels: Inherits trait/framework coverage from source corpora
theory.instruments_or_method: Cross-lingual attention distillation and multilingual augmentation
theory.multi_theory_notes: Theory score reflects inherited source frameworks only; language-agnostic transfer is the main contribution

provenance.text_source: Augmented or translated text derived from existing personality-labeled corpora
provenance.collection_context: Augmented dataset protocol (tan_2026), not a new primary human corpus
provenance.access_and_license: Depends on source data access and augmentation pipeline release
provenance.known_limitations: Generated/translated examples need native-speaker or local-instrument validation

datasets.name: Deimann
datasets.suggested_use: Reddit-scale MBTI stress-test where filtering and label ambiguity must be audited
datasets.note: Type: original dataset or study-dependent collection. 2024 Reddit aggregation study (deimann_2024) reports about 6.6M collected comments and about 4.06M comments after preprocessing. Strong naturalness and scale, but governance remains study-dependent unless the exact collection, filtering, leakage control, and split protocol are released.

theory.traits_or_labels: 16 MBTI types; Jungian dominant-function variants in some settings
theory.multi_theory_notes: Large-scale Reddit MBTI study with documented filtering and unfiltered-data concerns

provenance.label_source: Self-proclaimed MBTI labels on Reddit users/profiles
provenance.access_and_license: Study-dependent unless the exact scrape, filtering, and split protocol are released
provenance.known_limitations: Platform-specific behavior; MBTI-topic leakage; filtering, label ambiguity, and unfiltered-data issues

datasets.name: JAM-style LLM-filtered theory synthesis
datasets.suggested_use: LLM-filtered/cleaned synthesis from Essays + focal-loss split plus Kaggle dataset + focal-loss split under focal-loss protocol; partial theory-extension credit because it combines and filters rather than fully validating two theories
datasets.note: Type: augmented dataset. LLM-filtered synthesis over Essays + focal-loss split and Kaggle dataset + focal-loss split (jie_nd_b; jie_nd; tan_2025; tan_2026_b). Partial theory-extension credit for combining and filtering source frameworks, but it does not yet validate two personality theories as interchangeable measurement targets.

theory.traits_or_labels: Combined Essays/big-5 and Kaggle/MBTI source frameworks under LLM filtering
theory.multi_theory_notes: Partial theory-extension credit for combining source frameworks; not yet interchangeable multi-theory validation

provenance.text_source: LLM-filtered or cleaned synthesis from Essays + focal-loss split and Kaggle dataset + focal-loss split
provenance.label_source: Inherited and transformed from source datasets
provenance.collection_context: Augmented dataset built from source corpora under tan_2025/tan_2026_b workflow
provenance.access_and_license: Depends on source corpus access plus published synthesis protocol
provenance.known_limitations: Inherits source label noise; synthetic outputs need cross-language and demographic validation

datasets.name: CPED
datasets.suggested_use: Chinese dialogue benchmark for interactional and cross-cultural exploration
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Large public Chinese personalized/emotional dialogue dataset. Stronger scale than most English-only small corpora, but row-level labels may not equal stable real-person traits.

theory.traits_or_labels: Big Five-style personality labels in Chinese personalized/emotional dialogue
theory.instruments_or_method: Three psychology-major annotator projective ratings on dialogue rows
theory.multi_theory_notes: Useful for dialogue research; row labels may not equal stable real-person traits

provenance.known_limitations: Row-level dialogue labels may not equal stable real-person traits

datasets.name: EAR
datasets.suggested_use: naturalistic behavioral-language research with strong observation depth but restricted reproducibility
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Naturalistic EAR transcriptions with strong observation depth, but unavailable public access limits governance and reproducibility for ordinary benchmarking.

theory.traits_or_labels: Big Five O, C, E, A, N
theory.instruments_or_method: Self-report Big Five ratings linked to naturalistic behavioral sampling
theory.multi_theory_notes: Gold-standard ecological sampling design for psycholinguistic validity research

provenance.text_source: Transcribed snippets from Electronically Activated Recorder everyday conversations
provenance.label_source: Self-report Big Five ratings from the original EAR program
provenance.access_and_license: No usable public download path identified
provenance.known_limitations: High ecological value but poor reproducibility as a public benchmark

datasets.name: Essays + focal-loss split protocol
datasets.suggested_use: controlled big-5 benchmark with curated data and personality-stratified focal-loss splitting
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Controlled big-5 essays from pennebaker_1999 and jie_nd_b; Essays + focal-loss split protocol cites tan_2025 for personality-stratified evaluation. Strong label clarity and governance, but low naturalness and observation depth.

theory.traits_or_labels: Big Five O, C, E, A, N
theory.instruments_or_method: Self-report and observer/projective ratings in the original stream-of-consciousness study
theory.multi_theory_notes: Controlled-writing benchmark with clear big-5 framing and long citation history

provenance.label_source: pennebaker_1999 labels plus curated jie_nd_b release
provenance.access_and_license: Public curated dataset DOI and original study DOI
provenance.known_limitations: Controlled writing limits ecological validity; one main sample per participant

datasets.name: FriendPersona
datasets.suggested_use: dialogue/persona modeling with fictional-character validity limits
datasets.note: Type: original dataset. Public dialogue corpus from fictional television characters. Useful for persona modeling, but fictional dialogue limits real-person psychometric validity.

theory.traits_or_labels: Big Five-style persona ratings on fictional characters
theory.instruments_or_method: Three-annotator projective ratings on dialogue lines/characters
theory.multi_theory_notes: Dialogue/persona modeling resource rather than a real-person psychometric corpus

provenance.label_source: Three-annotator projective ratings on fictional characters
provenance.known_limitations: Fictional/scripted dialogue is not spontaneous real-person communication

dimensions.label: Label grounding
dimensions.description: Validated questionnaires, reliability evidence, trained raters, documented self-declaration, or reported label provenance.

dimensions.label: Text naturalness
dimensions.description: Everyday, longitudinal, platform-native, or interactional communication, as opposed to scripted, generated, or meta-discussion text.

dimensions.label: Scale (size)
dimensions.description: Corpus size in users, documents, words, comments, or rows, with cohort-relative normalization.

dimensions.label: Observation
dimensions.description: Repeated observations per person, longitudinal coverage, multiple posts or comments per user, and user-level aggregation.

dimensions.label: Theory coverage
dimensions.description: Representation of Big Five, MBTI, HEXACO, Enneagram, facets, cross-theory mapping, or uncertainty-aware label design.

dimensions.label: Language coverage
dimensions.description: Multilingual text, locally validated instruments, native-speaker review, and language-held-out evaluation.

dimensions.label: Demographic diversity
dimensions.description: Participant diversity, geographic metadata, demographic distributions, representativeness reporting, and bias analysis.

dimensions.label: Governance & reproducibility
dimensions.description: Public or restricted access clarity, stable download path, license/terms, reproducible splits, class-balance reporting, documented preprocessing, and leakage control.
